package com.convoscribe.data

/**
 * Lifecycle of a [SessionEntity], from "we just hit record" to
 * "the speakers are labelled". A failed diarization lands on
 * [DIARIZATION_FAILED] so the UI can still show the transcript and
 * a Retry button without blocking the rest of the session.
 */
enum class SessionStatus {
    RECORDING,
    TRANSCRIBED,
    DIARIZING,
    DIARIZED,
    DIARIZATION_FAILED
}

/**
 * What kind of [ChatMessageEntity] this is. Summary messages are the
 * output of the LLM "summarise" action; Q&A messages are user
 * questions paired with assistant answers.
 */
enum class MessageKind {
    SUMMARY,
    QA
}

/**
 * Who produced a [ChatMessageEntity] entry. A Q&A round produces two
 * rows with the same [MessageKind] but different [MessageRole]s.
 */
enum class MessageRole {
    USER,
    ASSISTANT
}

prepend_path "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools"

# CMake directory layout: setup-toolchain.sh installs the version pinned by
# CMAKE_VERSION inside scripts/setup-toolchain.sh. We add any matching directory
# we can find so env.sh does not have to know the current version.
for cmake_dir in "$HOME/.local/share/convoscribe-toolchain"/cmake-*/bin; do
  if [[ -d "$cmake_dir" ]]; then
    prepend_path "$cmake_dir"
    break
  fi
done

## 2026-10-15 — TASK-19 — Diarize sessions after recording (use case + service action + crash recovery)

Added `diarization/DiarizeSessionUseCase.kt`: `class DiarizeSessionUseCase(repository, diarizerFactory, settings, readSamples = WavReader::readMono16k)` whose `suspend fun run(sessionId, onProgress = {})` flips the session to `DIARIZING`, exits straight to `DIARIZED` (via `applyDiarization` with empty map / 0 speakers) when there are zero segments without ever invoking the diarizer, otherwise reads the WAV on `Dispatchers.Default`, runs `diarizerFactory.create().use { it.diarize(samples, s.numSpeakers, s.clusterThreshold, onProgress) }`, maps `SegmentEntity` rows to `SegmentSpan`, calls `SpeakerAssigner.assign`, and writes the assignment through `repository.applyDiarization`.
